record.title: FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time
record.titleEn: FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time
record.titleKu: FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time
record.description:
FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time is a social slow-life RPG from LEVEL5 built around 14 selectable Lives. Players can fight monsters, gather materials, cook, craft equipment, build and decorate, develop an island, and explore a large fantasy world.

The story follows an adventurer who reaches a mysterious island and moves between its present state and a past era a thousand years earlier while investigating the events that led to its downfall. Multiplayer supports up to four players online or through local wireless, while Family Co-op allows a second player to join on one system with two controllers.

record.tagline: Choose among 14 Lives, travel between past and present, rebuild a mysterious island and create your own rhythm of combat, gathering, crafting and exploration.
fitFor: Players who enjoy life simulation mixed with action RPG progression, crafting and collecting.
Players who want freedom to change jobs and activities instead of following a single combat class.
Families and friends who value online/local-wireless multiplayer and two-player Family Co-op.
notFitFor: Players who want a tightly linear action game with little crafting or resource gathering.
Players who dislike long-term collection, job progression and town/island customization systems.
Players seeking a purely competitive multiplayer game rather than cooperative/social play.

gameplayPillars.title: Fourteen Lives
gameplayPillars.description: Combat, Gathering and Crafting Lives each offer their own progression and activities, and the player can switch between them freely instead of being locked to one class.

gameplayPillars.title: Restore and Shape the Island
gameplayPillars.description: Gather materials, build structures, alter terrain, draw roads and rivers, expand your home and decorate interiors as the island develops.

gameplayPillars.title: Open-World Adventure and Multiplayer
gameplayPillars.description: Explore Ginormosia and other regions using climbing, swimming and mounts, then invite friends for exploration, dungeons and cooperative activities.

record.worldSummary: The adventure begins on Mysteria Island in the seas of Reveria. A dragon fossil guides the player and archaeologist Edward’s expedition to an uncharted island marked by a vast abyss, a Bone Dragon and a message from a mysterious girl. The player can travel between the island’s ruined present and its flourishing state 1,000 years in the past, gathering materials and clues that help restore the present-day settlement.

storyChapters.title: A Dragon Guides the Expedition
storyChapters.body: The player sails with archaeologist Edward’s team and follows light from a fossilized dragon toward a deserted, uncharted island.

storyChapters.title: One Thousand Years in the Past
storyChapters.body: A mysterious event opens a way to the island as it existed 1,000 years earlier, letting the player investigate what caused its downfall.

storyChapters.title: Restore the Present
storyChapters.body: Materials, relationships and discoveries gathered across the adventure feed into rebuilding the present-day island and uncovering its central mystery.

faq.q: How many Lives are available?
faq.a: There are 14 Lives spanning combat, gathering and crafting, and the player can switch between them during the adventure.

faq.q: Does FANTASY LIFE i support multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists one-to-two players on one system, one-to-four local wireless and one-to-four online, plus a two-player Family Co-op feature.

faq.q: Is there a Nintendo Switch 2 Edition?
faq.a: Yes. LEVEL5 released a separate Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and an upgrade path with higher resolution, higher frame rate and faster loading.

record.verdictSummary:
Score note: 8.6/10 is a direct normalization of the current 86/100 Metacritic aggregate for the Nintendo listing; it is not a separately invented store rating.

FANTASY LIFE i succeeds by letting the player decide how much time to spend fighting, crafting, gathering, decorating or exploring. The time-travel island structure gives those relaxed systems a clear story purpose, while extensive multiplayer makes the world easy to share.
verdictPros: Fourteen Lives create unusually broad activity and progression variety.
Island restoration and open-world exploration reinforce the slow-life fantasy theme.
Strong cooperative options including online, local wireless and Family Co-op.
verdictCons: Players who dislike gathering/crafting loops may find progression repetitive.
The large number of systems can feel busy at the beginning.
Original Switch presentation is less advanced than the dedicated Switch 2 Edition.

record.studioAbout: KOEI TECMO GAMES develops and publishes Japanese console and PC titles. The remake rebuilds the 2003 horror classic with new visuals, audio, controls, exploration systems and Camera Obscura mechanics.
setupNeeds: Nintendo Switch 2 system required for the Nintendo Switch 2 version.
Internet connection is required for digital download, updates and online/service features where applicable.
Nintendo Account required for Nintendo eShop purchase/download.
Sufficient internal storage or compatible microSD Express storage required.
Nintendo Switch Online membership is required only for game-specific online multiplayer/features that explicitly use it.

faq.q: Is this an official EA edition name?
faq.a: The game title is official; the Regular/Deluxe/Complete/Ultimate labels below are the user’s store package tiers and are not assumed to be identical to EA’s official commercial editions.

faq.q: Does it support local multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo football releases support shared-system matches, with exact limits depending on mode.

faq.q: Does it support online play?
faq.a: Yes in supported game modes; an internet connection and account requirements apply.

faq.q: Why are Switch 1 and Switch 2 separate for newer FC titles?
faq.a: Where EA publishes separate platform versions, the extraction keeps them as distinct files rather than treating backward compatibility as a new edition.

faq.q: Are the package tiers official EA editions?
faq.a: No assumption is made; they are preserved exactly as the supplied storefront pricing tiers.

verdictCons: Some features differ by Nintendo generation
Store package labels should not be confused with official EA editions

record.titleEn: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

features: Improved Switch 2 frame rate and resolution
record.perfResolutionDocked: Improved resolution — exact official number not published
record.perfResolutionHandheld: Improved resolution — exact official number not published

faq.q: What does the Switch 2 Edition improve?
faq.a: Nintendo explicitly states improved frame rates and resolution; the game content itself is unchanged.

faq.q: Are exact resolution and FPS numbers published?
faq.a: Nintendo’s product/upgrade page confirms improvements but does not provide exact numeric targets.

faq.q: Is there an upgrade path?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists a Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack.

faq.q: Is it multiplayer?
faq.a: No. It is a single-player tactical RPG.

faq.q: What is the core progression system?
faq.a: Characters change jobs, learn abilities, and combine skills to create specialized tactical builds.

verdictCons: Battles can be slow for action-focused players
Grinding jobs may appeal mainly to strategy fans
Exact Switch 2 performance figures are not officially published
